description: Baselined contrast pairs for the semantic-token contrast gate (Requirement 37 AC 2 / Task 56.2). The gate requires every semantic-token pair to clear 7:1 in both light and dark modes. The pairs listed below are below 7:1 today; the gate enforces that they do NOT regress below the recorded ratio while they are tightened toward 7:1 in follow-up tasks. PRC-M430 (Topic 23) raised every baselined pair to meet WCAG 2.1 AA (>= 4.5:1) and added a NON-WAIVABLE 4.5:1 floor in check-contrast.mjs: a baselined pair can never drop below AA. The 7:1 gate threshold is unchanged. To remove a row, raise the offending token's contrast in packages/ui/styles/theme.css until it clears 7:1, then delete the entry. The threshold is intentionally a couple of hundredths under the measured value so the gate is robust to floating-point noise. See tools/scripts/README.md.

light.name: accent-foreground / accent
light.note: PRC-M430: --accent darkened 40%->28% L. Measured 5.61:1 (AA). Reach 7:1 by darkening --accent further or using neutral-900 as foreground.
